subject: Lockbox handshake: DPA, SOC 2 & SIG clarifications
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha@fintrail.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Thomas Reed <t.reed@fintrail.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + lockbox details we need for procurement

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement/legal here at FinTrail asked me to capture a couple of security/retention items so we can close the MAP this month. High-level asks: 

- We need a copy of your latest SOC 2 (Type II) and confirmation of the scope (production inference, control plane, logging).
- CAIQ/SIG answers for typical cloud controls (we submitted a CAIQ template during intake).
- DPA redline: we'll push our standard DPA with a few data-residency and retention clauses, but procurement wants to understand Redwood's stance on a third-party lockbox/escrow for keys and long-term archival (7 years for transaction logs).
- Retention windows: for PII-minimal logs vs transaction data; any options for EU-only residency for a scoped tenant?

I've attached the MAP workbook we started (FinTrail_MAP_v1.xlsx). Can you confirm what evidence you'll provide and a close timeline? Legal would like a signed MAP and DPA in the next three weeks if possible.

Appreciate a short bulleted response we can share with legal.

—Asha
Procurement, FinTrail Bank

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@fintrail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + lockbox details we need for procurement

Hi Asha —

Thanks — clear list. Quick answers up front, then next steps below: 

- SOC 2: we can provide the full Type II report covering production inference and control plane; scope excludes developer test environments. I'll attach the last report and a short scope summary.
- SIG/CAIQ: Kimberly will pull our CAIQ export and highlight any non-standard answers; we can share a redacted copy for procurement.
- DPA & lockbox: Redwood is open to a limited lockbox model (customer-controlled KMS keys with split-key escrow or third-party escrow). We typically offer:
  * Customer-managed CMEK in a supported cloud (preferred)
  * Optional escrow with an audited third-party (arranged case-by-case; there is a one-time setup review)
- Retention & residency options: we support region-scoped tenancy for EU/US and configurable retention tiers. For transaction logs we can support 7-year archival via cold storage (encrypted) and produce an access and export path for audits.

Proposed MAP close milestones (high level):
1) Week 0–3: SOC2 + CAIQ delivery, DPA redline exchange
2) Week 1–4: Legal review & DPA finalization
3) Week 2–5: Technical onboarding for EU residency if requested; escrow setup if chosen

Next steps: Kimberly — can you attach SOC2 report and CAIQ extract? Vanessa — can you confirm our standard escrow vendor options and a rough estimate of setup lead time? Asha/Thomas — if you can send the FinTrail DPA redline, we'll get legal review queued and propose a DocuSign envelope.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk legal/security through the lockbox options. Are you available Mon 4/19 or Tue 4/20 afternoons PT?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise GTM (Redwood Inference)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha@fintrail.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + lockbox details we need for procurement

On Fri, Apr 17, 2027 at 11:03 AM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick answers up front, then next steps below: 

Hi Asha — adding detail so your legal team has a checklist they can use directly. Attachments: SOC2_report_2026.pdf (stub), CAIQ-responses-compact.xlsx.

Checklist / evidence we can provide (deliverables we typically include in the MAP):
- SOC 2 Type II (PDF) — full report + separate cover letter summarizing scope and in-scope endpoints.
- CAIQ/ SIG Lite export — spreadsheet with redlines on any "limited" answers.
- DPA redline turnaround: 48–72 business hours for initial legal review on standard redlines; novel escrow/legalhold requests may need direct counsel call (we can arrange same-week).
- Lockbox/escrow: options are (a) customer-managed CMEK (preferred), (b) third-party escrow via our partner (audited provider), (c) hybrid split-key. Requirements for escrow: SLA for key retrieval, audited access logs, and a technical runbook — we'll share a stub.
- Retention profiles:
  * Short-term logs (7–30 days): default
  * Transactional records: configurable 7 years archival in encrypted cold storage
  * PII-minimal telemetry: configurable, default 90 days

Acceptance criteria to mark MAP milestone "security gate cleared":
1) DPA executed with agreed retention table or an approved carveout
2) SOC 2 Type II delivered and stakeholder signoff
3) CAIQ exported and non-blocking items documented + acceptance by FinTrail security
4) If EU residency requested: tenancy scoped and onboarding runbook signed-off

I'll upload the CAIQ extract to the shared Drive and flag any answers we should discuss. If FinTrail needs legal counsel on escrow wording, loop in Vanessa and our GC team and we'll set a short counsel-to-counsel call.

Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Programs, Redwood Inference

From: Thomas Reed <t.reed@fintrail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha@fintrail.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + lockbox details we need for procurement

Thanks Logan and Kimberly — useful detail. A few clarifications from FinTrail legal/security: 

- Residency: We do require EU-only residency for the scoped tenant (EU customers and EU payment rails). Can Redwood confirm a dedicated EU tenancy (not just geo-fenced storage)?
- Retention: For certain transaction logs required for regulatory audit, we must retain 7 years. We are OK if those are in cold encrypted storage, but they must be searchable for e-discovery and exportable with chain-of-custody logs.
- Escrow & legal hold: We prefer an independent escrow vendor and a documented legal-hold process. Also want clarity on how Redwood responds to subpoenas and law enforcement requests for EU-scoped data.

We'll attach our DPA redline (redline_dpa_fintrail.docx) and can accept an initial call with Redwood counsel this week. Proposed call: Tue 4/20 11:00 AM PT.

—Thomas
General Counsel, FinTrail Bank

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Reed <t.reed@fintrail.com>, Asha Patel <asha@fintrail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + lockbox details we need for procurement

Thomas — appreciate the clarity. Confirmations and next steps: 

- EU tenancy: we can provision a dedicated EU-scoped tenant (isolated project/network/security boundaries) for the FinTrail production environment. Technical onboarding for EU tenancy typically takes 7–14 business days once we have a signed MAP and the tenant spec sheet.
- 7-year retention: supported via encrypted cold archival with a searchable index and export tooling; we will include chain-of-custody logs for any export. We will document the retention table in the MAP workbook and the DPA.
- Escrow/legal-hold: Vanessa is coordinating our escrow partner options and will circulate the escrow runbook + vendor certs. For law enforcement requests, our policy is to require jurisdictional gating and notify the customer unless prohibited; we'll provide the standard process description and GC contact.

Actions assigned: 
- Kimberly: finalize CAIQ export + upload SOC2_report_2026.pdf to the shared Drive (ETA EOD Fri 4/23).
- Vanessa: send escrow vendor options and estimated setup time (ETA Tues 4/21).
- Logan (me): schedule counsel-to-counsel call for Tue 4/20 11:00 AM PT and prepare a DocuSign envelope for the MAP + DPA once we get the redline.

Asha/Thomas — I'll send the calendar invite and a one-page MAP close checklist you can share with procurement/legal.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.
Logan Wright
Enterprise GTM, Redwood Inference
